title: Unauthenticated Presenter Identity Assertion

antecedent.preserved_boundary: P4-F01-S01 established cryptographic binding between a permit and the presenter identifier supplied to the governed execution path. It did not establish independent authentication of the caller supplying that identifier.

question: Can a harness-modeled Agent B present an Agent-A-bound permit while supplying presenting_agent_id as Agent A, with otherwise-valid human authority and execution material, where the governed execution path has no independent authenticated representation of the actual caller?

identity_distinction.actual_caller_agent_id: Harness ground truth only. This value represents which modeled upstream principal invokes the request and is intentionally not supplied to the V07 governed execution path.
identity_distinction.presenting_agent_id: The presenter identifier actually supplied to ToolRequestV07 and checked against the permit-bound agent_id.
identity_distinction.permit_agent_id: The normalized agent identifier cryptographically bound inside ExecutionPermitV03.

cases.purpose: Positive control establishing that correctly modeled Agent A presentation remains executable when all other controls are valid.
Positive control establishing that correctly modeled Agent B presentation remains executable when all other controls are valid.
Adversarial case isolating whether the runtime independently authenticates the caller behind the supplied presenter identifier.

required_controls_preserved: Same legitimate human authority context across relevant cases.
Permit signature and permit identity remain valid.
Policy, permission, target, tool and consequence material remain otherwise valid.
P4-F01-S01 predecessor evidence is not modified or rerun.
No change is made to V03 or V07 before first observation.
required_observations: Whether ToolRequestV07 contains a native independently authenticated caller identity distinct from presenting_agent_id.
Whether P4-F02-NEG-ASSERT-A commits when actual caller ground truth is Agent B but the supplied presenter identifier and permit binding both state Agent A.
Whether any refusal in the adversarial case is specifically attributable to independent caller-authenticity verification rather than another control.
Whether witness evidence natively records an independently authenticated actual caller identity distinct from permit_agent_id and presenting_agent_id.
Whether the witness chain remains valid.
bounded_interpretation: If the adversarial case commits, the finding is limited to the tested V07 reference path: it would show that matching a cryptographically bound permit agent_id to a caller-supplied presenting_agent_id does not by itself establish who actually supplied that identifier. The harness-modelled actual caller identity is external ground truth and is intentionally not passed into V07. This test does not establish production exploitability, network spoofing feasibility, credential theft, swarm compromise, distributed-system compromise, tenant escape, remote attackability, or compromise of any external identity provider.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not modify P4-F01 or P4-F01-S01 evidence.
Do not rerun P4-F01 or P4-F01-S01.
Do not add an authentication control before the first P4-F02 observation.
Do not hard-code rejection of Agent B.
Do not describe harness-only actual caller ground truth as a runtime-authenticated identity.
Do not generalize a bounded result into swarm security or production exploitability.
